  This page presents a synoptic index of expository study notes produced during
  my self-study of foundational and frontier topics in mathematics and
  theoretical physics.  The notes are arranged by subject area and each
  hyperlinked entry provides a self-contained exposition aimed at advanced
  undergraduates or beginning graduate students who wish to master the material
  in a systematic manner.  All resources are open-access: the web versions can
  be read online directly, while ancillary PDFs compiled via Overleaf are
  available for download.  Both formats are version-controlled through
  GitHub/Quarto to ensure continuous updating and public traceability.
